name: Damage Classifier Improvement (8-Phase Plan)
objective: Lift damage classifier from baseline (acc 86.7%, bal 79.8%, recall 91.6%, 8 FN) to acc>=90%, bal>=85%, recall>=95%, FN<5 with zero backend inference regression.
exit_criteria: Error audit CSV generated; FN/FP inspected (user-informed label fixes)
Model factory + resnet18 training path works; checkpoint carries arch metadata
Backend loads arch from checkpoint metadata (custom + resnet18 both)
Threshold sweep executed on val; selected threshold written to config/metadata
Winner copied to models/egg_grader_resnet18_v1.pth (or best candidate name)
Backend regression tests pass (7 crop cases + existing tests green)
Acceptance checklist: acc>=90, bal>=85, recall>=95, FN<5, no leakage, backend OK
constraints: Label 0 = Damaged, label 1 = Not Damaged; class_names order (Damaged, Not Damaged)
Test set untouched until threshold finalized (leak prevention)
Moderate aug only — no transforms hiding cracks
Model selection: balanced accuracy + damaged recall, never plain accuracy
Reject model if acc>=90 but damaged recall regressed vs baseline 91.6%
No backend regression: damage_status, damage_confidence, damage_model_version, review_reason, Needs Review
Reports under reports/; venv ./.venv/bin/python; scripts from repo root
Approval gate: training runs need approval; Phase 2 label edits irreversible → user decides
STOP on test fail; report → propose → approve → fix
